thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: p99 latency spike detected for customer SableBridge on eu-west. p99 > 2.8s across dedicated pool sb-eu-west (10m). Suggested runbook: dedicated-p99-containment.
oncall-sre: I’m awake, oncall here. Picking this up. @eng-infra-jay @ml-ops-sarah can you jump in?
eng-infra-jay: looking at metrics now — pool sb-eu-west shows GPU utilization 92% on two nodes, tail queue length increased. Network egress fine.
ml-ops-sarah: KV cache miss ratio jumped ~45% last 8m, aligns with a model variant rollout at ~12:05 UTC. Could be cache churn from longer contexts.
support-luis: I just spoke with customer-ops-bob (SableBridge). They report 5-12s latencies on their payment rerank route, started ~12:03 UTC. They’ve throttled clients down but impact ongoing.
acct-amy: Customer is on enterprise SLA; ops-manager-nina advised immediate escalation — they’re on a live demo in APAC at 12:30 local.
eng-infra-jay: plan proposal: 1) isolate tenant to warm spare nodes, 2) roll traffic to a compatible model variant (quantized) as fallback, 3) pause rollout. Will execute in that order.
oncall-sre: thumbs up. Start isolation and pause rollout. Keep me posted for handoff.
eng-infra-jay: executing tenant isolation now: `redwood route move --tenant sablebridge --from sb-eu-west --to sb-eu-west-warmspare --grace 10s`
eng-infra-jay: isolation started — routing change in progress. Watching conn drain.
ml-ops-sarah: pausing model rollout in model-catalog: `modelctl rollout pause model/sb-rerank/variant-2026-03-17`
ml-ops-sarah: also pushing fallback config to use quantized variant vQ4_8 for this tenant: `deploy config override --tenant sablebridge --model vQ4_8`
support-luis: Bob: "Thanks — we see some immediate improvement but still intermittent spikes on long prompts." He sent an example prompt, forwarded to ML.
eng-infra-jay: warmspare nodes showing lower CPU/GPU. p95 dropping from 1.9s -> 1.1s, p99 now ~2.2s (was 3.4s). Good signal.
ml-ops-sarah: KV cache warmup still catching up. For longer prompts we see re-eval of KV pages. Temporary mitigation: enable aggressive prefix caching for this tenant: `cachectl set --tenant sablebridge --policy aggressive --ttl 10m`
eng-infra-jay: doing that now. Also increasing batch size cap modestly to reduce per-token overhead: `runtime set --pool sb-eu-west-warmspare --max-batch 64`
ops-manager-nina: heads-up: this will slightly raise latency tail risk for other tenants on the warmspare, confirm impact?
oncall-sre: only SableBridge on these warmspare nodes currently after isolation, OK to increase for now.
support-luis: Customer confirms p95 improved, p99 still has rare 6s tails. They’re asking for ETA to full remediation.
ml-ops-sarah: suspect residual cold KV items plus the fallback quantized variant has slightly different decoding that affects some long sequences — working with model infra to revert to previous variant for long-route only if safe.
eng-infra-jay: opening mitigation ticket: RED-INC-12345. Will coordinate rollback if needed.
oncall-sre: perform a canary rollback of the model rollout for just sb-rerank route? Recommended only if we see regression after warmspare + caching.
ml-ops-sarah: starting a targeted rollback canary to the prior variant for the rerank route: `modelctl rollback --tenant sablebridge --route rerank --to variant-2026-03-10 --canary 5%`
eng-infra-jay: canary deployed. Monitoring: initial 5% looks fine, no error increase. Latency on canary subset ~1.0s p95.
support-luis: customer on call now, they see the canary session responding normally. They want us to keep them updated and request a post-incident summary.
acct-amy: noted — will arrange SLA credit discussion if root cause shows rollout caused customer impact. Also setting up a follow-up meeting.
ops-manager-nina: handoff plan: if we get stable p99 < 2.0s for 15m, mark incident mitigated and proceed to postmortem. If spikes recur, escalate to capacity ops for possible pool scale-up.
oncall-sre: agree. Current metrics: p99 1.8s over last 7m. Continue monitoring, keep thread active until 15m stable.
eng-infra-jay: documenting actions in RED-INC-12345 and recording exact node IDs moved: node-88,node-89 -> warmspare nodes 201-204.
ml-ops-sarah: also saving the offending prompt sample to incident artifact store: `s3://redwood-incidents/RED-INC-12345/sample-prompts.txt`
support-luis: Bob: "We appreciate the quick response — we can keep traffic at reduced rate for next 30m while you validate."
oncall-sre: thanks team. If stable at 15m, I’ll close the war room and assign postmortem to eng-infra-jay + ml-ops-sarah + support-luis.
ops-manager-nina: tagging for PM review: please include rollout gating improvements and a checklist for tenant isolation handoff.
eng-infra-jay: closing loop: isolation successful, fallback applied, targeted rollback canary OK. Monitoring continues.
oncall-sre: marking timeline checkpoint at 7461244500. Will update status in PagerDuty and close if stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident RED-INC-12345 updated: status = mitigation_in_progress, severity = high, owner = oncall-sre
